text:
Noah: Quick flag — weekly ops dashboard is showing inbound leads drop Wed->Fri, organic looks particularly low. Anyone else see this?#
Aisha: Yep saw that this morning. Landing -> MQL conversion dropped from ~4.2% to ~2.1% across the board. :thinking:#
Maria: Digging in. First pass shows a big rise in `utm_source=unknown` for those dates. Running the attribution join now. :mag_right:#
Maria: ```
-- sample query I'm running
SELECT date, utm_source, COUNT(*) as sessions, SUM(is_mql) as mqls
FROM events.sessions
WHERE date >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,3 DESC
```#
Maria: Query returns ~1.2k sessions flagged as unknown source between 2026-03-17 and 2026-03-19. Most hits have the consent banner param present. :confused:#
Sam: If unknown spikes then paid could be undercounted. CMP changed Monday, right? Could be stripping tags or delaying the UTM capture until consent. #
Aisha: CMP rollout was Monday 10:00 UTC. We also pushed a small GA tag update Tue morning — timing aligns. :white_check_mark:#
Noah: Stakeholders want the weekly KPI email Monday. Should we mark the dashboard numbers as suspect and hold the email until we confirm? #
Maria: I can add a "data_confidence" flag for affected dates and start a backfill that reassigns sessions when we can recover UTMs. Starting now; ETA ~3h. #
Maria: PR opened to add the confidence column and logic: https://github.com/redwood/marketing-dash/pull/412 :link:#
MetricsBot: Deploy scheduled at 04:00 UTC — heads up in case the ETL overlaps. :robot_face:#
Maria: This is an ETL backfill, not a production deploy. Should be fine, but I will coordinate with infra if it needs more resources. I'll post status updates here. #
Aisha: If backfill fixes numbers, can we regenerate the weekly email and include a short note about CMP attribution noise? I'll draft the note. :memo:#
Sam: Also advise Sales — we might have duplicates or misattributed leads in the CRM for those days. @Sam can you check dedupe rules for March 17-19? #
Sam: On it. I’ll pull the CRM lead export and sanity-check common emails/domains. ETA 90m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:#
Noah: Cool. If we can't confidently repair attribution before Monday, label the KPIs as "data under review" in the email and include the CMP/launch note. Don't hard-stop the cadence. #
Maria: Backfill is 22% done. First pass shows ~60% of unknown sessions can be recovered by joining server-side landing params. #
Aisha: Great progress. Ping me when it's done and I'll update the email draft. :thumbsup:#
MetricsBot: Backfill job status: running (job_id=bf-20260317-01) — progress 22%. ETA ~2h 45m. #
Maria: If anything fails I'll open a rollback ticket and we can mark the week as suspect instead of trying to patch. Will update here in ~30m. #
Noah: Thanks team. Keep this thread for status so ops and execs can follow. :eyes:
